Package Overview and Compatibility

Choose a workflow, preserve input meaning and reuse saved results safely

spax-package allocation-compatibility
Spatial accessibility and allocation modeling

Public FCA Accessibility

Raster accessibility surfaces with model-specific normalization and independent supply indicators

spax_2sfca()
Calculate Original Two-Step Floating Catchment Area (2SFCA) accessibility scores
spax_e2sfca()
Calculate Enhanced Two-Step Floating Catchment Area (E2SFCA) accessibility scores
spax_m2sfca()
Calculate Modified Two-Step Floating Catchment Area (M2SFCA) accessibility scores
spax_3sfca()
Calculate Three-Step Floating Catchment Area (3SFCA) accessibility scores
spax_huff2sfca()
Calculate Huff-model Two-Step Floating Catchment Area (Huff-2SFCA) scores
compute_access()
Calculate spatial accessibility using weighted surfaces

Access Interface (experimental)

Specify a floating catchment area index without data: its decay (distance weights with a sigma, a step or an inverse decay), its normalization and its selection. spax() computes it on data from prep_data(): raster data give the spax object of the one-call functions, numeric data the index at each origin

spec_2sfca() spec_e2sfca() spec_m2sfca() spec_3sfca() spec_huff2sfca() format(<spax_fca_spec>)
Specify a floating catchment area index without data
decay_step() decay_inverse() format(<spax_fca_decay>) print(<spax_fca_decay>)
Declare a step or inverse decay for an FCA specification
format(<spax_access_values>) print(<spax_access_values>) summary(<spax_access_values>) print(<summary.spax_access_values>) as.data.frame(<spax_access_values>)
Methods for FCA indices on numeric data

Allocation Interface (experimental)

Prepare data, specify an allocation model without data (decay kernels, fitted or held parameters), declare observed counts, run the model and work with its result

prep_data() format(<ae_prepared_inputs>) print(<ae_prepared_inputs>) format(<spax_raster_data>) print(<spax_raster_data>)
Prepare data for a spax model
decay_gaussian() decay_exponential() decay_power() decay_custom() format(<spax_decay>) print(<spax_decay>)
Declare a decay for a model specification
spec_clm() spec_huff() format(<spax_allocation_spec>) format(<spax_spec>) print(<spax_spec>)
Specify an allocation model without data
obs_flows() obs_totals() print(<spax_obs>)
Declare observed counts for an allocation model
spax()
Run an allocation model on prepared data
spax_huff() spax_clm()
Run the Huff or conditional logit model from raw inputs
print(<spax_allocation>) summary(<spax_allocation>) print(<summary.spax_allocation>) coef(<spax_allocation>) fitted(<spax_allocation>) as.data.frame(<spax_allocation>) predict(<spax_allocation>)
Methods for allocation results

Allocation Steps (experimental)

The step functions under spax(), for full control: prepare inputs, declare the model, fit, evaluate, predict, check, compare and bootstrap. Prediction, check, compare and bootstrap also accept a result of spax()

prepare_allocation()
Prepare numeric inputs for the allocation model
clm_allocation()
Declare a static conditional logit allocation model
huff_allocation()
Declare the Huff model
fit_allocation()
Calibrate a declared allocation model, by default from starts found in the data
evaluate_allocation()
Evaluate a declared allocation model at supplied fixed parameters
predict_allocation() print(<ae_clm_prediction>)
Predict requested origins against a saved fitted or evaluated CLM
check_fit() check_allocation() print(<ae_allocation_check>) as.data.frame(<ae_allocation_check>)
Check what fitted facility counts identify in an allocation model
compare_fits() compare_allocations() print(<ae_allocation_comparison>) as.data.frame(<ae_allocation_comparison>)
Compare fitted allocations across model and input specifications
bootstrap_fit() bootstrap_allocation()
Conditional facility-case bootstrap for a fitted allocation
coef(<ae_problem_nfxp_fit>) coef(<ae_multistart_fit>) fitted(<ae_problem_nfxp_fit>) fitted(<ae_multistart_fit>) summary(<ae_multistart_fit>) summary(<ae_problem_nfxp_fit>) print(<ae_multistart_fit>) print(<ae_problem_nfxp_fit>) print(<summary.ae_problem_nfxp_fit>)
Inspect saved allocation fits without recomputation
as.data.frame(<ae_problem_nfxp_fit>) as.data.frame(<ae_multistart_fit>) as.data.frame(<ae_coverage>) as.data.frame(<ae_allocation_bootstrap>)
Inspect saved allocation result tables
print(<ae_allocation_bootstrap>) summary(<ae_allocation_bootstrap>) print(<summary.ae_allocation_bootstrap>) plot(<ae_allocation_bootstrap>)
Inspect a saved facility bootstrap
print(<summary.ae_multistart_fit>)
Print a saved allocation multistart summary
plot(<ae_multistart_fit>) plot(<ae_problem_nfxp_fit>)
Plot saved diagnostics from the selected allocation fit
